title: BJP single-largest party in Rajasthan urban polls, denied sweep by Independents
content: The recent urban local body elections in Rajasthan showcased the significant influence of independent candidates on the outcome. Although the BJP secured the most seats, they did not dominate as expected, while Congress demonstrated resilience by winning important contests in several towns. The strong showing by independents indicates a shift toward local issues rather than party allegiance. Additionally, the announcement of results was hampered by technical glitches in some areas.

title: Scotland, Northern Ireland and Wales sign historic MoU to break away from UK
content: Leaders from Scotland, Northern Ireland, and Wales signed a pact seeking independence. This historic agreement signals a shift away from Westminster's long-standing control. The first ministers are committed to self-determination for their respective nations. They also aim to strengthen cooperation on economic and energy matters. This pact reflects a growing desire for constitutional change across these regions.

title: Oracle layoffs: Employees receive ‘6am job cuts’ email from Oracle leadership again
content: Oracle layoffs began again on September 14, with employees across the US reporting the same 6am email from "Oracle Leadership" that landed in March. Logins were disabled around 4am, Slack access dropped by 5.30am, and Slack counts fell by 3,000 to 4,000. OCI, Fusion, NetSuite, Oracle Health and the Abilene Stargate site were hit. India's Development Centre is expected next, as Oracle's restructuring bill climbs to $2.8 billion.

title: Jemima Goldsmith, 52, remarries; 22 years after divorce from Imran Khan
content: Jemima Goldsmith has married Irish-Australian financier Cameron O’Reilly at the age of 52, marking her second marriage. The couple reportedly met through their work and had been friends before beginning a relationship. Jemima’s family confirmed the wedding, which comes 22 years after her divorce from former Pakistan prime minister Imran Khan.

title: 'Why wasn't FIR slapped on Justice Varma?' Senior lawyer Mahesh Jethmalani

Lawyers also criticized the opaqueness in judicial appointments and transfers.

title: BJP stays on top, Cong gets a warning: What Raj civic polls result means for 2028
content: The recent civic poll outcomes in Rajasthan underscore the enduring hold of the BJP despite some setbacks. Both the Aam Aadmi Party and CPM saw significant advancements in certain districts. Meanwhile, it was a mixed bag for the Congress. The Congress victories were scattered even as it ceded some ground to emerging opponents. Independents also played a pivotal role, and this may affect the formation of local boards.

title: Massachusetts dairy turns manure and food waste into $155,000 annual savings
content: Jordan Dairy Farms in Rutland, Massachusetts, embraces cutting-edge anaerobic digestion technology to revolutionize waste management. By transforming cow manure and food scraps into energy and fertilizer, the farm not only boosts its sustainability but also slashes operational costs. This innovative approach not only supports the farm’s productivity but also significantly mitigates its environmental footprint, showcasing a model for responsible agriculture.

title: Perez Hilton cuts Las Vegas mansion price by $350,000 after Miami move

title: UP polls & the fight for Muslim votes: Decoding SP, Congress's Owaisi problem

title: Trinity Rodman’s inspiring journey: How did she overcome Dennis Rodman’s shadow?

title: Legendary fashion designer Bob Mackie dies at 87

content: the state school education department has withdrawn its approval for the Akshaya Patra Foundation . the foundation served cooked mid-day meals at state-run schools in parts of four districts . school heads said arrangements were not ready for the foundation to supply cooked meals across the areas .

title: Mob attacks house church service in Bengal
content: a house church service was attacked by a mob of 40-45 chanting ‘Jai Shri Ram’ . a female devotee was abducted and later rescued by police . the mob allegedly issued a directive demanding an immediate halt to all church services .

title: Indian travel vlogger claims ‘arrest’ by Afghan ‘Mujahideen’, seeks help
content: "Backpacker Arunima" is a popular travel vlogger from Kerala . she claims she was "arrested" by the "Mujahideen" in Bamyan . "if you anyone know Indian embassy please contact," she wrote .

title: Britain’s wasps are unusually scarce this summer, and scientists are puzzled
content: wasps that usually gather around outdoor food, patrol gardens and become noticeable in late summer appear unusually scarce in 2026 . the shortage has become so pronounced that researchers are struggling to collect enough insects for laboratory experiments . scientists suspect volatile spring weather, repeated heatwaves and reduced food supplies may have disrupted colonies before they could grow .

title: ‘No help whatsoever’: Trump seeks reimbursement from nations for securing Hormuz
content: the countries of the world, which have been no help to us whatsoever, should, and will, reimburse the United States of America when this SCAM Confligration is all over . he says oil is continuing to flow through the strategic waterway and argues that the united states should be compensated once the conflict ends .

title: SC faults Abu Salem's maths, junks release plea
content: if a person is convicted in two cases and sentenced separately, the period of imprisonment undergone as an undertrial can be offset against only one of the sentences . the ruling was given by a bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Sandeep Mehta while detecting that gangster Abu Salem was extradited from Portugal on a solemn assurance by govt that he would not be awarded death penalty .

title: India to export 654MW of power to flood-hit Nepal daily till Dec 31
content: the ministry of power has agreed to export 654MW of electricity daily to flood-ravaged Nepal for 18 hours a day till Dec 31 . floods in the Trishuli/Lhende Khola river basin caused significant damage to hydropower infrastructure in Nepal . india started exporting up to 600MW electricity between midnight and 6pm .

title: ED arrests Bhupesh Baghels's ex-OSD for role in Chhattisgarh job scam
content: former CM Bhupesh Baghel's former OSD Chetan Borghariya has been remanded in six-day ED custody . ED is probing alleged money laundering relating to irregularities and manipulation in the CGPSC state service examinations .

title: '3 Cong CMs invited to Brics dinner but they didn't turn up'
content: a day before the dinner, three CMs chose to skip the dinner . the dinner was hosted by govt . no political blame game has occurred over the issue, but there have been past incidents of blame game . a CM from BJP-governed states was also invited .

title: Brazil election heats up: Lula, Flavio Bolsonaro locked in razor-thin runoff race
content: two opinion polls released on Monday showed the race tightening . aa BTG Pactual/Nexus survey put Lula narrowly ahead of Bolsonaro . Bolsonsaro led Lula 46% to 46%, his strongest showing since march .
